title: The Question Comes First

criteria.name: Hook & retention
criteria.notes: The first 0 to 5 seconds present a readable 19-contact hook and a concealed NEXT STEP page, with a coherent payoff at 93.14 seconds. The notebook keeps the question alive and the held-out person gets a second payoff at 107.78 seconds. The announcement, funding and training sequence at 13.72 to 28.68 seconds is more explanatory than arresting, despite its visible successive actions.

criteria.name: Illustration craft & detail
criteria.notes: The notebook has stitched binding, layered paper edges, turned corners, shadows and a consistent lit surface; the 33.9-second contact array has distinct ribs, shaded pads, fasteners, earclips and sockets. Hands carry cuff and finger detail. The reading book at 61.3 seconds and the large programming panel at 62.9 seconds have simpler, plainer surfaces than the notebook and instrument, leaving some within-style finish unevenness.

criteria.name: Motion & animation craft
criteria.notes: All forty sequential strips and seven action grids show real changes: the lab plate is carried and settles at 16.03 to 17.10 seconds, the fixed scalp contact is indicated at 32.23 to 34.37, Question B moves between inventory references at 88.10 to 90.77, the wing expands at 93.13 to 93.93, and the notched person travels directly into TEST at 107.8 to 108.6. Motion blur is visible on the selected recording strip at about 45 seconds. Repeated panel entrances and short arm translations do much of the acting; the small student at 36.64 to 40.01 seconds has a restrained pose range compared with the larger prop performances. This is a polish limitation, not a frozen-window blocker.

criteria.name: Composition & staging
criteria.notes: The 9:16 master consistently separates headlines, main actions and captions. The contact-to-trace relation at 33.9 seconds and training-versus-test layout at 111.4 seconds read clearly. At 88 to 92.6 seconds, archive shelving, the notebook, two question cards and several labels accumulate in the same central area, so the secondary notebook becomes less prominent. No unsafe informational crop or unreadable overlap observed. The square has not been assigned a separate artistic score.

criteria.name: Color & grade
criteria.notes: Warm lilac light, ivory paper, citron task tabs, coral accents and deep violet ink form a cohesive research-workspace world. The gradient, shaded props and restrained room finish are clean. The current state ledger records distinctly different September 10th and September 11th palettes, and this cut does not default to blue or repeat those recent worlds.

criteria.name: Typography & captions
criteria.notes: Open captions are large and high contrast in the current full-resolution samples; the 37 grouped caption cues retain the actual narration and correct September 9th, UAA and Egorov spellings. The delivered gate reports 220 aligned word cues. Headline and plate typography is consistent and readable. Some lower explanatory labels, notably the planned brain-activity label at 62.9 seconds, have less separation from the violet stage than the ivory headline plates, but remain readable. Type animation is mostly tied to panel movement rather than a highly varied kinetic system.

criteria.name: Sound design & mix
criteria.notes: The current delivered audio report and AAC check pass at -14.67 LUFS, -3.04 dBTP and LRA 6.9. The objective gate verifies 23 audible event lifts from 40 material-motivated cues, music provenance, and a 50.1 dB bed dip at 118.19 seconds. Paper, contact, slide and reveal events map to the visual actions; Life of Riley by Kevin MacLeod is legibly credited with its license at the ending. This score is based on the measured final mix and event evidence. I did not listen and make no claim about subjective timbre, pronunciation or musical taste beyond that evidence.

criteria.name: VO–illustration sync & entertainment
criteria.notes: The captions and actual sequential actions align: scalp emphasis accompanies the contact explanation at 32 to 34 seconds, the planned programming gaze movement remains distinct from the schematic brain trace at 65.25 seconds, the extra page opens on its narration at 93.14, and the person enters only TEST during the conditional generalization statement at 107.78. The notebook callback at 96.38 to 99.62 gives the explanation some personality. The document-heavy 13.72 to 28.68 and 113.1 to 118.94 passages are more didactic than playful.

criteria.name: Accuracy & sourcing
criteria.notes: All sixteen current claims map to the independently validated source findings. The 19 drawn scalp contacts can be counted as 2 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 2 in the full-resolution cutaway; two earclips and three sockets remain visually separate. Reading and programming remain prominently PLANNED, traces are SCHEMATIC, the archive retains its value, and 106.1 to 118.94 seconds explicitly separate the general new-person test principle from any UAA result. No unsupported price, accuracy, completed study or clinical benefit appears. The acquisition and training account mainly relies on the primary UAA announcement; the hardware count has additional manufacturer support. This review used the supplied independent source verification rather than re-fetching those pages.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & cultural respect
criteria.notes: The story credits UAA, its graduate student, faculty training and the Educational Legacy Fund, treating Alaska research capacity as a real local gain without inventing statewide sentiment. Generic schematic participants do not imply unverified identities or community endorsement. No imported savior narrative, Native iconography or unsupported cultural attribution observed.

criteria.name: Writing & post quality
criteria.notes: The post leads with a specific research-capacity win and earns its methodological limit. Narration is plain and concrete, the public-data countercase remains useful, and the closing question invites an actual task choice. The post preserves equipment-versus-results and recording-versus-interpretation distinctions and uses the Dispatch hashtag tail. The notebook metaphor carries the prose cleanly; the final methods clarification is slightly repetitive but protects the story from an inflated claim.

one_sentence_fix: For further polish, give the student at 36.64 to 40.01 seconds a clearer head-and-arm response to the trace and vary one label entrance in the 13.72 to 28.68-second funding and training sequence with a more consequential paper-handling action.
calibration_scope: Inspected all five preserved September 11th reference images and all three unchanged historical cards. Their medians describe that whole film, not independently scored stills and not an owner-approved aesthetic target. Used only to locate the within-style scale; no historical sound or pacing claim imported. The current threshold was read from the current rubric. No other current judge card was inspected.
evidence_limits: Visual review used all four current whole-film taste sheets, the current contact sheet, all forty sequential final-film strips, all seven supplemental action grids and eight full-resolution stills. It was not uninterrupted audiovisual playback.
Audio assessment uses current measured final-mix, alignment and event reports; no listening is claimed.
Primary-source facts were assessed against the supplied independent verification and final claim contracts; no fresh source refetch was performed.
identity_verification: Independently calculated the master SHA256 from its bytes and matched it to both the final-taste and action receipts; independently verified all seven action-grid file hashes.
overall_notes: The encoded evidence presents a coherent, legible, carefully bounded local research story with two paid-off visual questions. Current objective and required-preflight results pass. Remaining craft notes are within-style polish, with no hard blocker found.
